blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Semirara Mining and Power Corp. (SMPC) booked stronger earnings in the first nine months, even as its coal business suffered losses in the third quarter. The Consunji-led group reported Friday that its consolidated net income rose by 11 percent to P11 billion from P9.9 billion in the same period last year. Its power business did the heavy lifting, providing the bulk, or 78 percent, of the total profit. READ: Semirara bidding rules to ‘kill golden goose’–SMPC In the July to September period, SMPC’s net income also surged 66 percent to P2.4 billion from P1.5 billion.
